name: Regularity structures
summary: A systematic theory of singular subcritical SPDEs such as KPZ and Phi^4_3 built via local Taylor-like expansions and renormalisation.

name: Perfectoid spaces
summary: Scholze generalised Fontaine-Wintenberger to perfectoid spaces, with a tilting equivalence between char 0 and char p.

name: MIP*=RE: entangled provers, computability and the Connes embedding problem
summary: Verification with entangled provers was shown to capture exactly the halting-problem class, which refutes Tsirelson's problem and hence the Connes embedding conjecture.

name: Arc spaces of singularities and partition identities
from: commutative algebra / singularity theory (arc and jet schemes)
summary: Arc spaces of simple singularities were found to be described by partition identities, one of several fields where the Rogers-Ramanujan identities reappear and are re-proved with local tools.

name: Virtual fundamental cycles via homotopical algebra
summary: Homotopy-coherent methods give a rigorous construction of virtual fundamental cycles on moduli spaces of pseudoholomorphic curves, underpinning Floer and Fukaya theory.

name: Paracontrolled distributions
summary: Paraproduct calculus gave an alternative to regularity structures for singular SPDEs.

name: Ramanujan graphs / interlacing
summary: Marcus, Spielman and Srivastava proved existence of bipartite Ramanujan graphs of all degrees via interlacing polynomials, also solving Kadison-Singer.

name: Kadison-Singer via interlacing polynomials
summary: Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava solved Kadison-Singer using interlacing families of polynomials, a method arising from graph sparsification.

name: Liouville quantum gravity, the Brownian map and SLE
summary: Two models of random two-dimensional surfaces, one measuring area and one distance, were shown to describe the same object using SLE curves as the link.

name: Kakeya and Bourgain-Guth, decoupling for Vinogradov
summary: Bourgain-Demeter-Guth proved the main Vinogradov mean-value conjecture using l^2 decoupling from harmonic analysis.
